integrity: The infinite claim is proved symbolically from the exact nontrivial-divisor sums of primes, prime squares, and products of two distinct primes. A finite smallest-prime-factor computation is included only as corroboration.
scientific_limitations: The theorem closes only the boundary where both quasi-amicable members have at most two prime factors counted with multiplicity. It does not classify pairs once either member has Omega at least three, and it does not address the same-parity or infinitude problems.
title: A semiprime barrier for quasi-amicable pairs
